answers.core: This increases the possibilities with the particles node and removes the limitation and work of having to create a unique shader for a single particle.
answers.workaround:
This can be done using shaders, but require extra work, knowledge about shading and has some limitations.
I came across this [reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/godot/comments/m7ghar/make_2d_particles_use_local_rotation_but_not/) while looking for a solution that describes exactly the issue and the limitations it have.

title: Add a Local Rotation property to Particles
